agents.name: Read invoice PDF
agents.description: Read an invoice PDF the user uploaded and return its fields: supplier, invoice number, dates, currency, subtotal, tax, total, PO number, payment terms, and every line item. Use it whenever someone asks what an invoice says, what they are being charged for, whether a bill adds up, or wants an invoice turned into data. Two parts of the result matter more than the fields. `unreadable` names what could not be read off the document — those are null, not guessed, and you must not fill them in yourself. `checks` lists where the document disagrees with itself: lines that do not sum to the subtotal, a total that is not subtotal plus tax, a quantity times a price that is not the line amount. Report every check to the user in plain language; they are the reason to read an invoice with a tool rather than an eye. Find the file first with search_graph_objects (type 'file') and pass its object_id, or pass part of the filename as name.
reasons: The tool extracts supplier, invoice number, dates, currency, subtotal, tax, total, PO number, payment terms, and every line item from an invoice PDF, and performs validation checks.
uncertainties: Execution requires a fresh readiness check.

assessment.explanation: Several tools can extract invoice data with line items and validated totals as JSON. "Read invoice PDF" and "extract_invoice_data" can extract comprehensive invoice details including line items and totals from PDF. "extract_receipt" also extracts line items and totals as JSON. For verification, "Verify Invoice" checks arithmetic consistency and line-item totals. "invoice_tables" specifically extracts tables and line items, while "invoice_summary" offers a complete analysis with extracted fields, line items, and validation.
